qe: If the first half is written in the reverse order then which letter will be 7th to the left of 12th from the right end?
qh: यदि प्रथम अर्द्धांश को उल्टे क्रम में लिखा जाए, तो दाएँ छोर से 12वें अक्षर के बाएँ 7वाँ अक्षर कौन-सा होगा?
e:
Method 1 (First-Half Reverse Crossing Shortcut):
Step 1: Series structure samjhein:
- First half (A se M) reversed: $M, L, K, \dots, B, A$ (1 se 13 tak).
- Second half (N se Z) normal kram me hai: $N, O, P, \dots, Z$ (14 se 26 tak).
Step 2: Effective position from Right end nikalein (Right + Left):
$$\text{Position from Right} = 12 + 7 = 19\text{th letter}$$
Step 3: Right end (Z) se aate hue pehle 13 letters normal second half ke paar honge:
$$19 - 13 = 6\text{th letter from 'A' into first half}$$
- First half me 'A' se shuru karte hue 6th letter 'F' hota hai ($A=1, B=2, C=3, D=4, E=5, F=6$).
Correct option  F hai.

Method 2 (Left-End Conversion Method):
- Total letters = 26. Baayein chhor (Left) se sthiti $= (26 + 1) - 19 = 8$th from Left.
- Baayein chhor se 8th letter: $M(13)$ se countdown me $(13 + 1) - 8 = 6$th letter from $A$, jo 'F' hai.
Sahi uttar 'F' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If the first half is written in the reverse order then which letter will be 7th to the left of 16th from the right end?
qh: यदि प्रथम अर्द्धांश को उल्टे क्रम में लिखा जाए, तो दाएँ छोर से 16वें अक्षर के बाएँ 7वाँ अक्षर कौन-सा होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Boundary Shift Shortcut Trick):
Step 1: Right end se net position nikalein (Opposite directions = Addition):
$$\text{Position from Right} = 16 + 7 = 23\text{rd letter}$$
Step 2: Second half ke 13 letters nikalne ke baad first half me pravesh karein:
$$23 - 13 = 10\text{th letter from 'A'}$$
Step 3: English alphabet me 'A' se 10वाँ letter 'J' hota hai.
Correct option  J hai.

Method 2 (Left Position Calculation Method):
- Baayein se position $= (26 + 1) - 23 = 4$th from Left.
- Series ke shuruat ($M$) se 4th letter: $M(1), L(2), K(3), J(4)$.
Sahi uttar 'J' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If the first half is written in the reverse order then which letter will be 4th to the right of 13th from right end?
qh: यदि प्रथम अर्द्धांश को उल्टे क्रम में लिखा जाए, तो दाएँ छोर से 13वें अक्षर के दाएँ चौथा अक्षर कौन-सा होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Second Half Normal Shortcut Trick):
Step 1: Samaan dishaon (Right aur Right) ke liye ghataayein:
$$\text{Position from Right} = 13 - 4 = 9\text{th letter}$$
Step 2: Chuki $9 \le 13$, yeh letter normal second half ($N \to Z$) me hi sthit hai.
Step 3: Right end par 'Z' sthit hai, isliye 'Z' se 9th letter ki normal alphabetical position:
$$\text{Position from Left} = (26 + 1) - 9 = 18$$
18वाँ letter 'R' hota hai.
Correct option  R hai.

Method 2 (Direct Backward Counting from Z):
$Z(1), Y(2), X(3), W(4), V(5), U(6), T(7), S(8), R(9)$.
Daayein छोर se 9th letter 'R' prapt hota hai.
Sahi uttar 'R' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If the first half is written in the reverse order then which letter will be 11th to the right of 14th from the right end?
qh: यदि प्रथम अर्द्धांश को उल्टे क्रम में लिखा जाए, तो दाएँ छोर से 14वें अक्षर के दाएँ 11वाँ अक्षर कौन-सा होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Right-End Offset Shortcut Trick):
Step 1: Same directions (Right aur Right) hone par ghataav karein:
$$\text{Position from Right} = 14 - 11 = 3\text{rd letter}$$
Step 2: $3 \le 13$ hone ke karan yeh normal second half me hi hai.
Step 3: 'Z' se piche 3rd letter ki place value:
$$\text{Position from Left} = (26 + 1) - 3 = 24$$
Alphabet me 24वाँ letter 'X' hota hai.
Correct option  X hai.

Method 2 (Manual Inspection from Z):
Daayein छोर se: $Z(1), Y(2), X(3)$.
3rd letter 'X' hai.
Sahi uttar 'X' hai.

qe: If the first half is written in the reverse order then which letter will be 7th to the right of 10th from the left end?
qh: यदि प्रथम अर्द्धांश को उल्टे क्रम में लिखा जाए, तो बाएँ छोर से 10वें अक्षर के दाएँ 7वाँ अक्षर कौन-सा होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Crossing into Unchanged Second Half Shortcut):
Step 1: Baayein chhor (Left end) se position nikalein (Left + Right):
$$\text{Position from Left} = 10 + 7 = 17\text{th letter}$$
Step 2: Chuki $17 > 13$, yeh letter second half me aata hai.
Step 3: Second half ($N \dots Z$) bilkul normal kram me hai aur usme koi parivartan nahi hua hai. Isliye 17th letter original alphabetical series ka hi 17th letter hoga:
$$\text{Letter} = 17\text{th letter} = \text{'Q'}$$
Correct option  Q hai.

Method 2 (Offset into Second Half Method):
First half ke 13 letters nikalne ke baad: $17 - 13 = 4$th letter into second half. Second half 'N' se shuru hota hai: $N(1), O(2), P(3), Q(4)$.
Sahi uttar 'Q' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

e:
Method 1 (Reversed First Half Offset Shortcut):
Step 1: Samaan dishaon (Left aur Left) ke liye ghataayein:
$$\text{Position from Left} = 22 - 13 = 9\text{th letter}$$
Step 2: Chuki $9 \le 13$, yeh letter reversed first half ($M \dots A$) me hi sthit hai.
Step 3: 'M' (13) se shuru hone wali series me 9th letter ki normal position:
$$\text{Original Position} = (13 + 1) - 9 = 5$$
Alphabet me 5वाँ letter 'E' hota hai.
Correct 'E' hai.

Method 2 (Direct Counting from M):
Reversed first half: $M(1), L(2), K(3), J(4), I(5), H(6), G(7), F(8), E(9)$.
9th letter 'E' prapt hota hai.
